name: Shot on the Run
text:
Requirements You're wielding an area or automatic weapon.

By preparing your weapon while on the move, you ready yourself to fire a salvo as soon as you're in position. Stride up to your Speed, and then or .

name: Shoving Shot
text: Requirements You're wielding an area or automatic weapon. You use the blast of your weapon to push back your adversaries. You Area Fire or Auto-Fire. Your primary target must attempt a fortitude|against:soldier|options:forced-movement save against your class DC. Failure The target is pushed back 10 feet. If using an area (burst) weapon, the target is pushed away from the burst's center point. Critical Failure As failure, but the target is pushed 15 feet.

name: Shoving Shot
text:
Requirements You're wielding an area or automatic weapon.

You use the blast of your weapon to push back your adversaries. You Area Fire or Auto-Fire. Your primary target must attempt a save against your class DC.

Failure The target is pushed back 10 feet. If using an area (burst) weapon, the target is pushed away from the burst's center point.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is pushed 15 feet.

name: Show of Flame
text: Trigger A creature fails its Reflex save against your Fire Breath. Your flames are a fearsome sight to behold, blazing through all who oppose you. Choose one creature that failed its Reflex save against your Fire Breath. Attempt an Intimidation check to [[/act demoralize]] that enemy; you don't take a penalty for not sharing a language.

name: Show-Off
text: howing off isn't just something you do, it's part of who you are. You can use Performance to [[/act demoralize skill=performance]], [[/act lie skill=performance]], or [[/act make-an-impression skill=performance]]. If you've just done something impressive—such as rolling a critical success on an attack, save, or check—you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Performance checks for 1 minute, as the memory of your impressive feat hangs in the air. The GM has final say on if an action was impressive enough to merit this bonus.

name: Shroud of Shattered Spirits
text:
Frequency once per day

Trigger An enemy's Strike or targeted effect would hit you, and you weren't already Concealed, Hidden, or undetected to that enemy.
Your mere presence attracts restless spirits, haunted objects, spiritually active substances, and fragmented souls, like a magnet attracts metal. You manifest these spirit shards in a chaotic whirlwind around you that you barely control with your thoughts. You become concealed until the beginning of your next turn, and the flat check for concealment applies to the triggering Strike or effect that would've hit you. If the flat check fails, the Strike or effect misses you.

name: Shy
text: Whether through magical training, a technomagical body rig, or superior escape and evasion training, you've managed to learn how to fade from plain sight. You can cast Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB as a 2nd-rank arcane innate spell twice per day, but the spell has a duration of only 5 minutes each time.

name: Sidestep
text:
Trigger The attack roll for a Strike targeting you fails.

You deftly step out of the way of an attack, letting the blow continue to the creature next to you. You redirect the attack to a creature of your choice that's adjacent to you and within range or reach of the triggering attack. The attacker rerolls the Strike's attack roll against the new target.

name: Sidestep (Starfinder)
text: Trigger The attack roll for a Strike targeting you fails. You deftly step out of the way of an attack, letting the blow continue to the creature next to you. You redirect the attack to a creature of your choice that's adjacent to you and within range or reach of the triggering attack. The attacker rerolls the Strike's attack roll against the new target.

name: Siege Warrior
text: You are trained in operating crew-served weapons. You can operate siege weapons and mounted vehicle weapons as if they were one-person operated, without requiring another creature to aim.

name: Sigiled Scales
text: Your scales are marked with tiny sigils. When you select this feat, choose if you were blessed by a god or by an aberrant force. You can tap into the latent magic in your scales to cast a cantrip as an innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. If you are blessed by a god, choose one cantrip from the divine spell list. You can cast this cantrip as a divine innate spell at will. If you are blessed by an aberrant force, choose one cantrip from the occult spell list. You can cast this cantrip as an occult innate spell at will. Whenever you cast an innate spell granted by your Sigiled Scales or a feat that lists Sigiled Scales as a prerequisite, the sigils on your scales glow with magical energy, shedding bright light in a 10-foot radius for a number of minutes equal to the spell's rank.

name: Sign Language
text: You learn the sign languages associated with the languages you know, allowing you to sign and understand signs. Sign languages typically require both hands to convey more complex concepts, and they are visual rather than auditory. Sign language is difficult to understand during combat due to the level of attention needed, unlike basic gestures like pointing at a foe to suggest a target. Sign language is hard to use in areas of low visibility, just like speech is difficult in a noisy environment.

name: Signal Boost
text: [one-action] If your next action is to Cast a Spell that has a range, increase that spell's range by 30 feet. A touch-range spell becomes range 30 feet.

name: Silent Tide
text: Stalking great finned beasts through the kelp forests of Kalo-Mahoi has taught you to move silently and smoothly through the cover of foliage. While sneaking, you ignore difficult terrain caused by foliage and underbrush and treat greater difficult terrain caused by foliage or underbrush as difficult terrain. In addition, you can move at your full swim Speed when you Sneak while swimming. If you have another ability that allows you to move at full speed while Sneaking, you also gain a +2 status bonus to checks to Sneak while Swimming.

name: Singularity
text: Frequency once per hour Requirements You're graviton-attuned. You call upon a shred of the unstoppable cosmic force that eventually destroys all things. You concentrate and manifest the pinpoint center of a black hole within 60 feet. This occupies a single 5-foot space. Creatures within the singularity's space take (max((2*floor(@actor.level / 2) - 4),10))d8[void|options:area-damage] damage with a reflex|against:solarian|basic|options:area-effect save against your class DC. Any creature dropped to 0 Hit Points by this effect is torn asunder and pulled into the singularity, leaving no remains. Until the end of your next turn, light can't pass through the singularity's space and all adjacent squares, shrouding it in darkness that even creatures with darkvision or greater darkvision can't see through. Any creature that starts its turn in the darkness must succeed at a fortitude|against:solarian|basic|options:area-effect,inflicts:slowed save against your class DC or become Slowed 1 for that turn. Level (+2) Increase the damage by 2d8.

name: Siphon Solar Vitality
text: Your starburst markings store solar energy that you can tap into to revitalize your body and magically heal your wounds. You regain Hit Points equal to (@actor.level+ 1d6)[healing](1d6 plus your character level). If you're in an area of natural sunlight, you instead regain Hit Points equal to ((2*@actor.level)+1d6)[healing] (1d6 plus twice your character level).

name: Situational Awareness
text: You Ready a directive. If the trigger you designated occurs before the start of your next turn, you can use the 2-action version of the directive instead of the 1-action.

name: Situational Awareness

name: Six-Armed Barrage
text: You unleash a flurry of strikes with all six arms. Once per day as a 2-action activity, make up to three Strikes against one or more targets, each at a cumulative -2 penalty.

name: Six-Armed Juggler
text: Your six arms let you multitask seamlessly. You can Interact to draw or stow up to three items simultaneously as a single action.

name: Six-Limbed Efficiency
text: Your six limbs let you multitask with impressive efficiency. You can Interact to retrieve or stow an item as a free action once per round.

name: Size of the Ancients
text: Frequency once per day You undergo a rapid physical change, increasing in size to rival dragonkin of the ancient past. You grow to size Huge. Your equipment grows with you, but it returns to its natural size if removed or dropped. Your reach increases by 5 feet (or by 10 feet if you are a shipborn dragonkin), and you gain a +4 status bonus to melee damage. This transformation lasts for 10 minutes. You can end this transformation early as a single action that has the concentrate trait.

name: Size Up
text: Frequency once per hour You spend 1 minute observing a specific individual, 10 minutes researching a specific individual on the infosphere, or 1 hour networking and gathering information. This subject is your asset. If you assess your asset via observation, you don't need to know their identity, but if you assess your asset via research or networking, you must know their identity, which requires at least two relevant pieces of information about them. Examples of relevant information could include their name, their place of origin, their current residence, the name of their parent or significant other, their employer, or their organizational affiliation. The GM determines what constitutes relevant information for this purpose, based on the asset you've selected. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation, and Perception checks against or in relation to your asset, and a +1 circumstance bonus to attempts to Recall Knowledge about your asset. You gain the benefits of the 2-action Get 'Em! when using 1-action Get 'Em! on an asset. You can maintain a number of assets equal to your Charisma modifier. If you Size Up other assets after that, your new asset replaces a previous one.

name: Skill Synergy
text: Choose two skills. Each grants a +2 circumstance bonus to the other when attempting checks that can reasonably benefit from both skills.

name: Skill Training
text: You become trained in the skill of your choice. Special You can select this feat multiple times, choosing a new skill to become trained in each time.

name: Skilled Bodyguard
text: Your bulk and dexterous limbs are incredibly useful for ensuring that you keep your smaller allies out of harm's way. You move a number of willing, adjacent creatures that are smaller than you up to 5 feet each in a direction of your choice; the number of creatures you can move is equal to the number of unoccupied hands you currently have (including your inactive pair of hands). This counts as forced movement (meaning you cannot move a target into hazardous terrain or a space they cannot occupy). Special If you have the Titan Wrestler skill feat, you can use Skilled Bodyguard to move a creature of any size.

name: Skillful Encouragement
text: You offer an ally advice and encouragement, granting them the inspiration they need to push themselves further in the face of a challenge. During a combat encounter, select an ally within 60 feet. That ally gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their skill checks until the beginning of your next turn. That ally then becomes temporarily immune to your Skillful Encouragement for 1 hour. If you said this advice verbally, Skillful Encouragement gains the auditory trait. If you signed this advice, Skillful Encouragement gains the visual trait.

name: Skirmish Strike
text: You attack as you move, staying mobile as you fight and keeping your enemies on their toes. Either Step and then Strike, or Strike and then Step.

name: Skirmish Strike (Starfinder)
text: You attack as you move, staying mobile as you fight and keeping your enemies on their toes. Either Step and then Strike, or Strike and then Step.

name: Skitching
text: Requirements You have at least one hand free. While you're unable to accelerate as quickly as most vehicles, you can keep up with them by hanging onto them. Attempt an Acrobatics or Athletics check with a DC equal to the vehicle's AC. On a success, you hang onto that vehicle and remain adjacent to the vehicle as it moves, and you can Board the vehicle without an additional check. You can let go of the vehicle at any point without spending an action; if you do, you gain a circumstance bonus to your land Speed equal to the vehicle's Speed until the end of your next turn. Each time you move farther than your land Speed without this bonus, you must succeed at a Fortitude saving throw or lose control and move in a straight line up to your land Speed.

name: Skitter Wrastle
text: You're overeager to get to grips with your foes (or just give an ally an unexpected big hug). You Step and attempt an Athletics check to [[/act grapple]] a creature.

name: Skittermander Lore
text: You're gregarious and friendly but also passionately interested in the history of your people, going out of your way to learn traditional stories and unearth lost secrets. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Diplomacy and Society. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the general feat for Skittermander Lore, and you learn Morandomandranan, the original skittermander language that has long been suppressed by the Veskarium.

name: Skulking Strike
text: Trigger An enemy occupying the same space as you uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using. You launch a surprise attack from below. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If your attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, you disrupt that action. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

name: Sky-Save
text: Requirements You have at least one hand free and your target is no more than one size larger than you. You swoop down, use your arms to grab your friend, and fly them off to safety. You Fly or Tail Glide for each action you used to Sky-Save. At any point during this movement, you can seize hold of one willing ally within reach, taking them with you for the duration of your movement. When Sky-Save ends, choose if you are carrying the ally (making the ally ) or Release the ally (the ally must be willing to be Released).

name: Skyguard
text: You earned your space legs in the Skyguard, Kalo-Mahoi's space navy. You become trained in Piloting, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Piloting checks to Navigate and Stunt. If you're already trained in Piloting, you become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the Stunt Maneuver skill feat, even if you don't meet the prerequisites of the feat.

name: Sleep Mode
text: [free-action] (once per day) Trigger: you roll for initiative. You store dormant magic into your gear during daily preparations; your gear becomes overclocked.

name: Slick Mucus
text: Frequency once every 10 minutes You secrete a slick and slippery slime when speed is of the essence. Until the end of your turn, when you leave a square, you use Slime Squirt in that square. If you're Grabbed, Immobilized, or Restrained, you can attempt to Escape with a +2 circumstance bonus. You can then Stride. During this Stride, you have a +10-foot circumstance bonus to your Speed.

name: Slime Spray
text: Frequency once every 10 minutes With extra effort, you can spray your slime in a , causing the area to become difficult terrain for non-osharu creatures for 1 minute.

name: Slimy Osharu
text: You excrete more slime than most osharus. Slime Squirt no longer has a frequency. Additionally, you can Slime Squirt as a free action, but after using it as a free action, you can't use Slime Squirt again for 1 minute.

name: Slip From Sight
text: Frequency once per hour Trigger You successfully use Stealth to Hide and become Hidden from all your current foes, or use Stealth to Sneak and become undetected to all your current foes. Using clever technology, magical talent, a divine blessing, or uncanny luck, you slip from sight completely, becoming Invisible for 1 minute, or until you take a hostile action, whichever comes first.

name: Slip Through
text: Trigger You become Grabbed, Immobilized, or Restrained. Your slick fur assists you in sliding out of narrow crevices, slipping restraints, or evading the crushing jaws of predators. You attempt to Escape.

name: Slippery Secrets
text: You elude and evade attempts to uncover your true nature or intentions. When a spell or magical effect tries to read your mind, detect whether you are lying, or reveal your identity, you can attempt a Deception check against the spell or effect's DC. If you succeed, the effect reveals nothing.

name: Slowing Presence
text:
Frequency once per day

You surround yourself with alien energy that alters the perception of time for those nearby. For 1 minute, you gain a slowing presence aura in a 20-foot emanation around you. Enemies who enter the aura (or are in the aura when you activate it) must attempt a Will save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC with the following results. Afterwards, they are temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected by the presence.

Success The creature's dulled reaction times throw off its balance for a brief moment, causing it to become Clumsy 1 for 1 round.

Failure The creature is clumsy 1 and Slowed 1 for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is clumsy 1 and Slowed 2 for 1 round, and slowed 1 for 1 minute.

name: Smashing!
text: You focus your energy and concentrate on your target to find cracks and flaws you can exploit before you Strike. This Strike gains the razing trait, dealing additional damage to objects equal to double the number of weapon damage dice. On a critical hit, a targeted tech item becomes Glitching 1.

name: Smelling Brain
text: You have an entire brain just for processing scents. You gain imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet. This means you can use your sense of smell to determine the location of a creature. The GM will usually double the range if you're downwind from the creature or halve the range if you're upwind. In addition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks whenever you're trying to locate an undetected creature that's within the range of your scent.

name: Smiling False
text: You tell fibs so naturally that even as you're pulling the wool over their eyes, people see the best in you. You become trained in Deception. If you would automatically become trained in Deception (from a background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the skill feat.

name: Smoke Vision
text: You've gained the ability to see through smoke and fire with ease. You automatically succeed at the flat check to target a concealed creature if that creature is concealed only by smoke or fire. If you are an underworld dragon, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on Perception checks and DCs to Seek creatures hidden or undetected using only smoke or fire for concealment, or against Hide and Sneak actions by creatures hidden or undetected using only smoke or fire for concealment.

name: Smooth Diversions
text: You're practiced in the art of diverting attention quickly and subtly. When you succeed at an attempt to Create a Diversion, you can immediately Sneak or Step as a free action. Additionally, creatures only become aware you were trying to trick them if you critically fail to Create a Diversion. Otherwise the creature assumes that your diversion was part of your regular bravado.

name: Smooth Operator
text: Your glistening skin oils make it harder to pin you down. Whenever you roll a success on a check to Escape or a saving throw against an effect that would impose the Grabbed, Immobilized, or Restrained condition on you, you get a critical success instead. Whenever a creature rolls a failure on a check to [[/act grapple]], [[/act shove]], or [[/act trip]] you, it gets a critical failure instead.

name: Smug Affirmation
text: Having overcome countless challenges in your rise to power, your self-confidence isn't just bluster and brains; it's supported by empirical evidence! Your Shielding Arrogance reaction can now also trigger whenever a foe within range of your thoughtsense critically fails an attack against you or critically fails a skill check attempted against you (such as an Intimidation check to Demoralize you or an Acrobatics check to Tumble around you). Increase the number of temporary Hit Points you gain from Shielding Arrogance to [[/r 2d8]] plus your character level. Increase this by [[/r 1d8]] at 13th level and by an additional [[/r 1d8]] at 17th level.

name: Snap Shot
text: Even while threatened, you fire with precision. You do not trigger reactions from adjacent enemies when making ranged attacks, and you do not take the circumstance penalty from flanking enemies on ranged attacks.

name: Snap Shut
text: Frequency once per 10 minutes Trigger An enemy hits you with a Strike, or you attempt a Reflex save. Your reflexes kick in as you throw your armplates in front of yourself in times of danger. You drop all held items; if you have Bulky Armplates, instead choose one arm and drop anything it's carrying. You immediately [[/act take-cover]] and gain the effects of greater cover against the triggering attack.

name: Snow Vision
text: Seeing through snowfall is as natural for you as seeing through thin air. You automatically succeed at the flat check to target a concealed creature if that creature is concealed only by snowfall.

name: Soaring Leap
text:
Frequency once per day

With a flap of your wings, you make a mighty leap. You jump 30 feet in any direction. If you don't land on solid ground, you fall after using your next action, though if you have the Empower Wings feat or a fly Speed, you can Arrest the Fall.

name: Soaring Vulkarisu
text: You extend your broad membranes and flap your powerful arms in carefully controlled patterns, creating enough lift to carry you through the air. You gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed.

name: Social Chameleon
text: You integrated yourself completely into another culture, whether through honest immersion or duplicitous subterfuge. As a result, you've adopted the mannerisms of your hosts. You gain the general feat and your choice of a 1st-level common ancestry feat from the chosen ancestry.

name: Soft Paw, Sharp Claw
text: Trigger An ally attempts a Diplomacy or Intimidation check to [[/act coerce]] or [[/act make-an-impression]]. Brenneri ambassadors refer to alternating tones in negotiations as soft paw, sharp claw. If the triggering check is a Diplomacy check, you attempt an Intimidation check, and vice versa. Your ally uses the higher of the two results for their triggering check.

name: Soft Reboot
text: [reaction] (once per hour) Trigger: you Jailbreak Spell and your gear is no longer overclocked. You recapture just enough magic to overclock your gear again; your gear becomes overclocked.

name: Solar Barrage
text: You can fire off multiple shots with your solar flare in short succession. Make three solar flare Strikes against different targets, each with a –2 circumstance penalty. These attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after you've made the attacks.

name: Solar Barrage

name: Solar Flare
text: You can create and maintain a solar flare, but do not add your Strength modifier to damage rolls with your solar flare or any additional benefits based on your attunement.

name: Solar Manifestation Expert
text: Your proficiency ranks for solar flare, solar weapon, and your solarian class DC increases to expert.

name: Solar Nimbus
text: You gain the Nimbus Surge reaction, but do not gain any additional benefits based on your attunement.

name: Solar Rampart
text: Your training has helped you adapt to bulkier armor. You're trained in heavy armor. Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in medium armor, you also gain that proficiency in heavy armor. You treat armor you wear of 2 Bulk or higher as though it were 1 Bulk lighter (to a minimum of 1 Bulk).

name: Solar Rampart
text: Your training has helped you adapt to bulkier armor. You're trained in heavy armor. Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in medium armor, you also gain that proficiency in heavy armor. You treat armor you wear of 2 Bulk or higher as though it were 1 Bulk lighter (to a minimum of 1 Bulk).

name: Solar Shield
text: You've developed a new solar manifestation—a small shield of stellar energy that orbits you. This energy shield has the attuned and solarian traits and doesn't require a hand to use. You can Raise a Shield, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn. You gain the Shield Block general feat. Effect: Solar Shield While the shield is raised, you can use the Shield Block reaction with your shield. The shield has Hit Points equal to 5 plus twice your level and Hardness equal to half your level, rounded up. Your shield can't be broken, but if it's destroyed, you can't manifest a new shield for 10 minutes. If your shield vanishes due to you losing attunement, when you Attune to reform it, the shield returns with however many Hit Points it previously had. The shield regains all its lost Hit Points during your daily preparations and whenever you rest for at least 10 minutes, even if it's been destroyed. Graviton-Attuned If your shield is destroyed, it releases a shock wave. Adjacent enemies must succeed at a fortitude|against:solarian save against your class DC or be Suppressed for 1 round (2 rounds on a critical failure). Photon-Attuned If your shield is destroyed, it releases a flash of light. Adjacent enemies must succeed at a fortitude|against:solarian save against your class DC or be Dazzled for 1 round (Blinded for 1 round on a critical failure).

name: Solar Weapon Customization
text: You can select up to one trait for your solar weapon. When you reach level 6, you can choose a second trait, or the reach or two-hand 1d10 trait instead of two traits.

name: Solar Wind
text: You can partly discorporate your body, becoming a blur of stellar matter pushed by invisible solar winds. While photonattuned, you gain a +10-foot circumstance bonus to Speed and can move through the space of a single unwilling creature each time you Stride.

name: Solar Wind
text: You can partly discorporate your body, becoming a blur of stellar matter pushed by invisible solar winds. While photonattuned, you gain a +10-foot circumstance bonus to Speed and can move through the space of a single unwilling creature each time you Stride.

name: Solarian Dedication
text: You've attuned to a stellar mote. You gain a solar manifestation (a solar weapon or solar armor) and can enter a single attunement (graviton or photon) as part of a Strike or Stride. You become trained in your choice of one skill. Special: You can't select another dedication feat until you've gained two other feats from the solarian archetype. (Prerequisite Charisma 14 shown for reference; not enforced in-app.)

name: Solarian's Resiliency
text: You gain 3 additional Hit Points for each solarian archetype class feat you have. As you continue selecting solarian archetype class feats, you continue to gain additional Hit Points in this way.

name: Soldier Dedication
text: You've trained alongside professional soldiers. You become trained in martial weapons and in the soldier's primary saving throw if you weren't already; if you were already trained, you instead gain the critical specialization effect of one weapon group of your choice. Special: You can't select another dedication feat until you've gained two other feats from the soldier archetype. (Prerequisite Strength 14 is shown for reference but not enforced in-app.)

name: Soldier Resiliency
text: The grind of military service has toughened you. You gain 3 Hit Points, and you gain an additional 3 Hit Points for each level you have beyond 4th.

name: Soldier's Resiliency
text: You gain 3 additional Hit Points for each soldier archetype class feat you have. As you continue selecting soldier archetype class feats, you continue to gain additional Hit Points in this way.

name: Soldier's Toughness
text: Your proficiency rank in Fortitude saves increases to master.

name: Soldier's Training
text: Constant drills and combat experience leave you with reflexes capable of making snap decisions. Choose one soldier class feat you have that grants a reaction. At the start of your turn, you gain an additional reaction that you can only use for the selected class feat or an action granted by the selected class feat. You can change the reaction selected for this feat when you make your daily preparations as long as the new feat meets the requirements.

name: Solid Stance
text: When you stand on four legs, you dig into the ground firmly, making yourself particularly difficult to move. While in quadrupedal posture, you gain a +4 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude or Reflex DCs against attempts to [[/act reposition]], [[/act shove]], or [[/act trip]] you. This bonus also applies to saving throws against spells or effects that attempt to move you or knock you Prone. When you move, except to Stand, you lose the benefits of this feat until the beginning of your next turn.

name: Something to Protect
text: You speak a powerful line that emphasizes your convictions and unwillingness to give up. You and each of your allies that heard or saw you gains temporary Hit Points equal to your level and a +1 status bonus to Will saves, AC, and attacks until the start of your next turn.

name: Song of My People
text: You perform a mournful dirge tinged with supernatural grief that compels the soul of a lost comrade to return to its body. You can cast Breath of Life once per day as a 7th-rank primal innate spell. It gains the auditory trait.

name: Song of Whimsy
text: Frequency once per day Your performances, vocal or otherwise, can tap into the same riotous primal energy as that of the First World, warping reality to the whimsy of your soul's emotional spectrum. Roll [[/gmr 1d20 #Song of Whimsy]] and consult the table below for your result. If the result's emotion doesn't match your current soulfeel, attune your soulfeel to that emotion. If the effect requires a saving throw, use the higher of your class DC or spell DC. d20 Emotion Effect 1–3 Fury All enemies within 30 feet must attempt a Will save. If they fail, they become Confused for 3 rounds (or 1 minute on a critical failure), and their latent anger causes them to deal an additional ] damage with all Strikes against allies. 4–6 Joy You and all allies within 30 feet reduce your frightened conditions by 1, end any persistent mental damage, and gain 25 temporary Hit Points that last until the end of your next turn. 7–9 Sorrow All enemies within 30 feet become Suppressed until the end of your next turn and must attempt a Will save. If they fail, they become Slowed 1 for 3 rounds (or 1 minute on a critical failure). 10–12 Wonder All enemies within 30 feet become Dazzled until the end of your next turn and must attempt a Will save. On a failure, they become Stupefied 2 for 3 rounds (or 1 minute on a critical failure). 13+ Current soulfeel Select the effect that corresponds to your current soulfeel attunement.

name: Sonic Sync
text: Your crystals grant you a resonant defense against certain effects, though they often disrupt your soulfeel. You gain resistance 5 to sonic damage. In addition, if you critically fail a save against a damaging sonic effect, you can change your soulfeel to a different emotion as a free action.

name: Soothing Anchor
text: Frequency once every 10 minutes Requirements Your last action was to Sustain your quantum field or had the anchoring trait. You concentrate more deeply on your anchor to soothe yourself. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your witchwarper level that last for 1 round.

name: Soothing Anchor
text:
Frequency once every 10 minutes

Requirements Your last action was to Sustain your quantum field or had the anchoring trait.

You concentrate more deeply on your anchor to soothe yourself. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your character level that last for 1 round.

name: Soothing Protocol
text: Your connection calms the wounded. When you use Transfer Vitality, the target also removes one negative emotion condition (frightened, sickened) of value 1.

name: Soul Drinker
text:
When you have a creature in your grasp and at your mercy, you can sip and drink at their soul, granting you power if they are strong and making it harder for them to return from the dead. When you kill a creature that is grappled or restrained by you, you can choose to drink some of their soul. If they were a foe 2 levels lower than you or higher, you gain 10 temporary Hit Points and a +1 status bonus to attack and damage rolls for 1 minute. Either way, their injured soul makes it harder to raise them from the dead. Effects such as Raise Dead and Resurrect that would bring the creature back to life must first attempt to counteract your soul drinker, using the higher of your class DC or spell DC as the counteract DC.

Effect: Soul Drinker

name: Soul Furnace
text: Frequency once per affliction every 24 hours Your soul becomes fuel, burning away your life force to purge an affliction. Choose a disease or poison you're afflicted by. Lose a number of Hit Points equal to the level of the affliction. Attempt a new saving throw against the affliction, as though you were at the end of its listed interval. If you fail or critically fail this save, don't increase the affliction's stage.

text:

Attempt a new saving throw against the affliction, as though you were at the end of its listed interval. If you fail or critically fail this save, don't increase the affliction's stage.

name: Soul Sustenance
text: Your soul is radiant and can sustain your living body indefinitely, without the need for outside nourishment. You don't need to eat or drink, and you count your Constitution modifier as one higher while determining how much you heal from resting.

name: Soul-Soother
text: You have a deep understanding of emotions and mental health. You become trained in one of the following skills of your choice: Diplomacy or Medicine. If you would automatically become trained in both of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. In addition, if you roll a critical failure on a Will save against an emotion effect, you get a failure instead.

name: Soul-Sworn Bravery
text: You've deepened the bonds of your soul-sworn oaths. As long as you are within 10 feet of the target of your soul-sworn oath, you each gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Will save against fear effects. If you are both frightened, whenever the value of the frightened condition decreases for one of you, it decreases by 1 for the other as well.

name: Soul-Sworn Oath
text: You can swear a soul-sworn oath with one other willing sapient creature, empathically bonding your souls to one another. Swearing this bond is a 10-minute activity that you must both participate in. A soul-sworn oath lasts until you or the target choose to end it as a free action. You can only have one soul-sworn oath active at a time. If you attempt to swear a second soul-sworn oath, the first soul-sworn oath immediately ends. You and the target of this oath can communicate with each other mentally, as if you had limited telepathy with a range of 60 feet. In addition, as long as you can communicate mentally with one another, you share each other's languages.

name: Soulfire
text: Your understanding of your own emotions and soul deepens profoundly. You gain additional benefits depending on your current soulfeel attunement. Fury: You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Athletics checks. Joy: You gain a fly Speed of 20 feet. Sorrow: You gain a burrow Speed of 10 feet. Wonder: You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Perception checks. Special If you have , the summoned minion gains the same benefits of Soulfire as you.

name: Sound Mimicry
text: You can generate all manner of unusual sounds. While the sounds aren't distinct enough to mimic voices or otherwise produce speech, you can create almost any other kind of sound. You must attempt a Deception check check, with a +4 circumstance bonus, against the Perception DC of all creatures hearing the sound. On a failure, those creatures can deduce your attempt to mimic the sound; otherwise, they can't aurally distinguish it from a genuine sound.

name: Space Pirate Dedication
text:
As a plunder-seeking spacefarer, you become trained in Piloting, or become an expert in it if you were already trained. You have familiarity with all cutlasses, flails, rapiers, and weapons with the razing trait. For the purposes of proficiency, treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons. If you are at least expert, you gain that weapon's critical specialization effect.

Additionally, you gain the Holo-Roger action.

Space Pirate

name: Spaceflight Acumen
text: Your kind have crossed the void for ages. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Piloting and to saves against the effects of vacuum and extreme cold.

name: Spacewyrm Slayer
text: You remember tales of legendary dwarven heroes who battled spacefaring dragon raiders, and you keep their epic deeds alive in your heart. Select a magical tradition. When you successfully Strike against a dragon, you gain a circumstance bonus to your damage equal to the number of weapon damage dice. This bonus increases to double the number of weapon damage dice if your target dragon has the trait associated with the magical tradition you selected when you gained this feat.

name: Speak with Spirit
text: You can speak clearly with creation itself. You gain , , and as 4th-rank primal innate spells, and as a 5th-rank primal innate spell. You can cast one of these spells once per day.

name: Specialized Operative
text: Choose a specialization. You become trained in one skill determined by your specialization; if you were already trained in that skill, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain a skill feat associated with that skill. You don't gain any other benefits from your specialization.

name: Specialty Crafting
text: Your crafting skills are focused in a particular area. Choose a type of item; you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Crafting checks to create items of that type.

name: Spectra Ascendant
text: Whether through a quirk of your bloodline, the interference of powerful spectra, or Triune's blessing, your body has been flooded by the essence of the Drift, transforming you into a spectra. You cease aging. You gain darkvision, the cosmic trait, and a fly Speed equal to your land Speed. While you're in the Drift, your fly Speed is equal to double your land Speed. Additionally, you gain the Cosmic Blast action.

name: Spectra Transmission
text:
Frequency once per hour
You can project your speech through wireless transmission, rather than speaking aloud, causing your words to emit from unsecured technological devices as either audio, text, or both. For example, your voice could emit audibly from an intercom or appear as text on a vidscreen or holosign. Select an unsecured technological device within 100 feet. For 1 minute, you can choose to transmit anything you say through that output device, rather than say it aloud. You can change which device you use as an output as a single action. Doing so doesn't extend the duration.

name: Spectrasoul
text: You became a prismeni after a close encounter with one or more spectra. You can communicate mentally with spectra and with intelligent constructs with the tech trait within 30 feet. You don't need to share a language to communicate with such creatures in this way. This doesn't give you any special access to their thoughts and communicates no more information than normal speech would.

name: Speed of Thought
text: You have honed your telekinetic maneuverability, enabling greater bursts of speed. Increase your fly Speed by 5 feet. In addition, you gain the Telekinetic Sprint action.

name: Speedrun
text: You briefly hack reality, letting you pass through walls, ignore damage, and phase through enemies. You gain the speedrun magic hack.

name: Spell Circuit
text: [one-action] If your next action is to Cast a Spell from a spell chip or spell gem, you do not have to be holding the item.

name: Spell Library
text: During your daily preparations, you can add one spell of each rank you know to your spell cache until your next daily preparations.

name: Spell Protection Protocol
text: [one-action] You or an ally within 30 feet gains a 5-foot aura granting the target and allies in it a +1 status bonus to saves against spells and magic effects (+3 against spells you cast). The aura lasts until the end of your next turn; you can Sustain it up to 3 rounds.

name: Spell Sergeant
text: Your spells interface with technology in unusual ways. When you cast a spell that targets a technological creature or object, treat your spell level as 1 higher for determining effects.

name: Spellsail
text: You can ride the waves of energy left in the wake of your spells. If the next action you use is to that targets a creature within 60 feet, you teleport to an open space adjacent to the spell's target.

name: Spellshape Modder
text: [free-action] (once every 10 minutes) Trigger: your turn begins. Until the end of your turn, you gain a single technomancer spellshape feat with a level requirement of no more than half your level. You cannot apply that spellshape's jailbreak benefit.

name: Spellsurge Ammo
text: Frequency once per turn Trigger You cast a non-cantrip spell. You siphon spell energy into one weapon or grenade you're wielding. Until the end of your turn, the weapon or grenade deals extra force damage equal to the rank of the spell and gains the magical trait if it didn't have it already. If the spell deals damage, the extra damage becomes the same type as the triggering spell.

name: Spellsurge Ammo

Until the end of your turn, the weapon or grenade deals extra force damage equal to the rank of the spell and gains the magical trait if it didn't have it already. If the spell deals damage, the extra damage becomes the same type as the triggering spell.

name: Spellturning Scales
text:
Frequency once per day

 Trigger A spell of 7th level or lower targets you.

You quickly energize your scales with just the right magic to reflect your enemy's spell back at them. Attempt a counteract check against the triggering spell with a counteract level of 7 and a counteract modifier of your spell DC-10 or your class DC-10, whichever is higher. On a success, the effect is turned back on the caster. If the caster has a similar ability, such as the Spell Turning spell, they can use it to turn the spell back on you, in which case the attempt automatically succeeds; in the same way, you can use Spellturning Scales to automatically turn back a spell if a foe uses spell turning against your spell.

name: Spelunker
text: You're experienced in moving through spaces that are too small for you. This might be from the caverns of Apostae or a similar world. You become trained in Acrobatics. If you would automatically become trained in Acrobatics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the feat.

name: Spew Acidic Bile
text: Frequency once per day You spew bile in a broad spray, violently vomiting in a . Your bile deals ,(ceil(@actor.level/2)-2)d6[poison]|options:area-damage] damage to creatures in the area, with a basic Reflex save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. On a failure, a creature is also Sickened 1 (Sickened 2 on a critical failure). At 11th level and every two levels thereafter, the acid damage and the poison damage each increase by 1d6.

name: Spider Climb
text: Your adhesive limbs cling to any surface. You gain a climb speed equal to your land speed and can climb on ceilings without penalty.

name: Spiked Exoskeleton
text: You have spikes extending from your external shell. These spikes deal ] damage to a creature that grapples you or hits you with an unarmed attack.

name: Spinning Blades
text: Your drone gains the Spin to Win action (two actions): it deals its melee Strike damage to all creatures in a 20-foot emanation (basic Reflex vs your class DC) and can't do so again for 1d4 rounds; damage increases by 1d6 per 2 levels.

name: Spirit-Blessed Protections
text: The spirits of the planet Akiton protect you from being harmed by the forces of the natural world. You gain a +1 status bonus to saves against primal spells.

name: Spirits Protection
text: Frequency once per day Trigger You fail a saving throw. In times of great stress, you can still feel the flickers of your deceased partner's heartbeat pounding in time with yours, steering you to safety or girding your mind from assault. Their spirit still protects you from beyond the grave. You can reroll the triggering saving throw and use the better result.

name: Spiritual Wards
text: Your spiritual guardians ward you against all but the most potent of magics. You have resistance 20 against spirit damage and damage from primal spells.

name: Spitter
text: You can spit an acidic compound as a ranged attack. Once per day, you can spit acid as a ranged touch attack dealing 1d6 acid damage with a range of 15 feet.

name: Split Tunneling
text: [one-action] If your next action Casts a Spell without a duration that requires an attack roll against a single target, choose a second target within range. Roll one attack against both ACs (one attack for MAP). The second target takes only half damage and no effects beyond the initial damage.

name: Spongy but Strong
text: Your body is notably resilient, even for an ooze. You gain the Diehard general feat.

name: Spore Release
text: You expel a cloud of defensive spores. Once per day as a 2-action activity, creatures in a 10-foot emanation must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC = 10 + level + CON modifier) or become sickened 1.

name: Spore Shot
text: Frequency once every 10 minutes You channel extra spores into one of your spore pods, preparing it to choke your target. Make a spore pod Strike. If it hits, you deal spore pod damage as normal and your target must succeed at a fortitude save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC or become Clumsy 1 for 1 minute (or Clumsy 2 on a critical failure). You also gain the critical specialization effect for your spore pod Strike.

name: Spot Healing
text: Trigger An adjacent bonded ally takes damage. You quickly expend energy from your vitality network toward a bonded ally. Transfer Vitality to the triggering ally.

name: Spot Healing
text:
Trigger An adjacent bonded ally takes damage.

You quickly expend energy from your vitality network toward a bonded ally. to the triggering ally.

name: Spotlight
text: You can focus your light, shining it onto a specific location or target like a mobile spotlight to ensure no detail passes unseen. You shine a focused, bright light in a 5-foot radius burst within 40 feet (within 120 feet if you're a bright novian). You [[/act point-out]] one creature in your spotlight. Creatures gain a +1 circumstance bonus on Perception checks to [[/act seek]] within the area of this focused light. Spotlight lasts a number of rounds equal to half your level (minimum 1 round). While Spotlight is active, and for an hour after Spotlight ends, the area of your solar luminance is halved.

name: Spray Ink
text: Frequency once per round A special gland near your siphons produces a viscous ink that you can squirt at a foe within 15 feet. The target must attempt a reflex save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. The target then becomes immune to your Spray Ink for 1 minute. Success The target is unaffected. Failure The target is Dazzled until the end of your next turn. Critical Failure The target is Blinded until the beginning of your next turn and dazzled until the end of your next turn.

name: Spread the Love
text: Requirements You're wielding an area or automatic weapon. You skillfully line up your attack to harry two targets within your blast zone with equal lethality. You Area Fire or Auto-Fire, selecting two different primary targets, rather than one.

name: Spread the Love
text:
Requirements You're wielding an area or automatic weapon.

You skillfully line up your attack to harry two targets within your blast zone with equal lethality. You Area Fire or Auto-Fire, selecting two different primary targets, rather than one.

name: Spread the Wealth
text: Why should you keep all the luck for yourself? When you're a living, breathing good luck charm, it's important to spread the success to your friends, especially when they're in need of a helping hand. When you Aid, as long as you're an expert or better in the skill you're using, failures and critical failures to Aid instead count as successes.

name: Sprint
text: You sprint at top speed to chase down a foe or flee a dangerous situation. Stride up to four times. You can increase the number of actions this activity takes to 3 to Stride up to six times.

name: Sprint
text: You sprint at top speed to chase down a foe or flee a dangerous situation. Stride up to four times. You can increase the number of actions this activity takes to 3 to Stride up to six times.

name: Sprinter
text: Years of darting between cactus-like plants, climbing the twisting, gnarled trunks of kvashes, and leaping across giant chasms have paid off. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.

name: Spryflight
text: Your quick reflexes and impeccable balance assist you in zero gravity. You can in zero-g without needing a free hand. You also ignore the and penalties while in zero gravity.

name: Squirt Blood
text: You squirt blood from one of your eyes at a creature within 30 feet. The target must attempt a fortitude|against:class-spell save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, with the following results. Critical Success The target is unaffected. Success The target is disgusted by the display, becoming Sickened 1. Failure The target is struck in the face, becoming Dazzled for 1 round, or until they Interact once to clean the blood away. Critical Failure The target is struck in the face, becoming dazzled for 2 rounds, or until they Interact twice to clean the blood away.

name: Squishy Cover
text: You might blend into the background, but your allies can use your bulk as cover. When you [[/act hide]], one adjacent ally your size or smaller can use a reaction to Step and Hide behind you, gaining the Concealed condition until either one of you moves.

name: Squox Stance
text: Using a technique developed by studying the defensive motions of wild squoxes, you get on all fours and bury your claws deeply into the ground, wiggling your tail around in a frenzy as if it were a separate creature with a mind of its own. Until you move, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude and Reflex DCs against attempts to [[/act shove]], [[/act reposition]], or [[/act trip]] you. This bonus also applies to saving throws against spells or effects that attempt to move you or knock you . Furthermore, until you move, when you successfully [[/act feint]] a creature of your level or lower while that creature is flanking you, flanking doesn't make you to that creature (though that creature can still help its other allies flank you).

name: Stabilize Mass
text: You are able to maintain a larger size without suffering the usual drawbacks to agility. You are no longer Clumsy 1 from the Empowered Mass feat.

name: Stabilizing Core
text: Your gyroscopic body resists being knocked down. You are immune to falling prone from physical impacts and take no falling damage on flat surfaces.

name: Stand Aside
text: You use your large size and extra limbs to quickly aid your smaller allies in making room for you. Stride up to your Speed. If you end your movement in a position where one or more of your spaces are occupied by an ally, each such ally can immediately Step as a free action so that they are no longer occupying the same space as you. If this isn't possible, you must end your movement so that you aren't sharing a space with an ally, as normal.

name: Star Brand
text: Requirements Your last action was a successful solar flare or solar weapon Strike against a creature. You brand the creature with potent solar energy that keeps it visible and attracts your solar flare. When targeting the branded creature, increase the range increment of your solar flare by 60 feet. If the branded creature is Invisible, or later becomes invisible, it's Concealed instead. If the branded creature was already concealed for any other reason, it's no longer concealed. The brand lasts 10 minutes but ends immediately if the branded creature is slain or you Star Brand a different creature.

name: Star Brand
text:
Requirements Your last action was a successful solar flare or solar weapon Strike against a creature.

You brand the creature with potent solar energy that keeps it visible and attracts your solar flare. When targeting the branded creature, increase the range increment of your solar flare by 60 feet. If the branded creature is , or later becomes invisible, it's instead. If the branded creature was already concealed for any other reason, it's no longer concealed.

The brand lasts 10 minutes but ends immediately if the branded creature is slain or you Star Brand a different creature.

name: Star Flight
text: You have regained the full power of star flight, allowing you to soar through the stars. You can survive in the vacuum of space and move quickly between celestial bodies, bringing along other creatures. It usually takes a few days to reach distant locations in the same solar system, and months or years to reach other locations, though the timing and speed varies dramatically. For example, locations within the same solar system are usually 10,000 times closer than the nearest other solar systems, but it doesn't take decades or centuries to reach them. You can bring along one creature up to one size smaller than you, two creatures up to two sizes smaller than you, or four creatures up to three sizes smaller than you, and they are likewise protected from the vacuum of space.

name: Star Swimmer
text: You have adapted to swimming gracefully among the stars. You are not clumsy or Off-Guard while moving in zero-g environments. Additionally, you can move in zero-g using your swim Speed as though it were a fly Speed and you had the cosmic trait.

name: Starfinder Field Agent Dedication
text:
You are a trained agent of the Starfinder Society. You become an expert in Society. You gain the Additional Lore feat for Starfinder Lore; if you were already trained in Starfinder Lore, you also become trained in a Lore skill of your choice.
Special You can take this feat if you have the Xenoarchaeologist Archetype Dedication feat even if you haven't taken two additional xenoarchaeologist feats. Xenoarchaeologist archetype feats count as Starfinder field agent feats, and vice-versa, for purposes of completing the archetypes.

Starfinder Field Agent

name: Starfinder Provisions
text: The Starfinder Society provides you with provisions to aid you on your adventures. Each day during your daily preparations while you're in a settlement, a Starfinder Society delivery drone delivers two consumable items with an item level no higher than half your level. The drone might not be able to arrive if you're in a remote location or based on GM's discretion. If you receive a subsequent delivery and have items remaining from the prior delivery, you must return any unused consumables to the drone before receiving new stock.

name: Start Again
text: When a fight is about to break out, it's best to be on your toes; you take a split second to connect with your luck to stay ahead of the game. You can trigger Blue Mood after you roll initiative, in addition to its normal trigger, to reroll your initiative and take the higher of the two results. This counts as a usage of Blue Mood, as normal.

name: Startling Shift
text: Frequency once every 10 minutes You pulse and strobe your pigmentation in bright and luminescent tones to confuse and distract your enemies. Attempt a deception check and compare it to the Will DC of each creature in a . The creatures are then temporarily immune to Startling Shift for 24 hours. Critical Success The creature is Fascinated by you for as long as it can see you (unless it stops being fascinated, as normal for the condition) and is Dazzled for 1 round or as long as it's fascinated, whichever is longer. Success The creature is fascinated by you for 1 round and is dazzled for 1 round. Failure The creature is dazzled for 1 round. Critical Failure The creature is unaffected.

name: Stash for Later
text: Alright, you admit it: you're a bit of a hoarder. But you maintain that all those things you've been squirreling away aren't useless! In fact, you swear you'll find a use for them one day! If only you can remember where you stashed everything... You become trained in Survival. If you're already trained in Survival, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You can spend 3 actions burying up to a light Bulk of goods, or 10 minutes burying up to 10 Bulk of goods. This usually requires suitable terrain you can dig through, such as loose dirt or sand, but a GM might allow you to bury your stash in other terrain, such as a junkyard or behind the drywall of an office building. In most cases, creatures have a chance to detect your stash only if they use the [[/act seek]] action to attempt a Perception check against your Survival DC. If you're relatively close by, such as in th

name: Stash Steal
text: You know how to prepare for the unforeseen and can instantly recognize the signs of buried stashes from others who share your diligence. You gain the general feat. You can use Prescient Planner as a 2-action activity once per day to find a buried stash of goods, and you can procure ammunition and batteries in addition to the usual items available. These items must meet the usual level, Bulk, and other requirements, and you must still pay the price of the chosen item, usually by buying similar goods and burying them for later, even if that means other vulkarisu get to it first.

name: Statistical Anomaly
text:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You critically fail a saving throw or skill check.
It's unclear whether your luck is very good or very bad; more research may be necessary. Reroll the triggering check or save and use the second result. If the triggering skill check is for Delve Lore or the triggering saving throw is to avoid a trap's effects, the frequency for this effect becomes once per 10 minutes.

name: Steady Advance
text: An object in motion stays in motion, and a person of your mass is rarely acted upon by an outside force. You Stride twice or Push Off once, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to your AC against any reactions triggered by your movement. A creature that attempts such a reaction and fails its attack roll becomes until the beginning of your next turn.

name: Steady Balance
text: You can keep your balance easily, even in adverse conditions. Whenever you roll a success using the Balance action, you get a critical success instead. You're not Off-Guard while attempting to Balance on narrow surfaces and uneven ground.

name: Steady Descent
text: By making minor adjustments to gravitational forces on your body, you make a controlled descent instead of falling. You glide slowly toward the ground, 5 feet down and up to 25 feet horizontally through the air. As long as you spend at least 1 action gliding each round and haven't yet reached the ground, you remain in the air at the end of your turn. If you use Steady Descent in zero gravity, you instead move up to half your fastest Speed in a direction of your choice.

name: Steady Pilot
text: Triaxian traditions make you a natural pilot. You become trained in Piloting (or gain a skill increase) and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to keep control of a mount or vehicle.

name: Steady Trinket
text: One of your personal trinkets has seen you through a long illness, recovery from an injury, or days aboard a ship dealing with motion sickness. Holding on to the object fills you with memories of being treated with tender care. You suppress the sickened condition for 10 minutes.

name: Stealth Prodigy
text: You vanish like a shadow. You can hide even when only partially obscured and gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks made to hide.

name: Steel Yourselves!
text: As a single action, grant up to four allies within 60 feet a +1 status bonus to their next saving throw. This lasts until the start of your next turn.

name: Stellar Rush
text: While attuned to photon, you move through space at stellar speed. You gain a +10-foot status bonus to speed, and when you Stride and Strike in the same turn, your Strike deals an additional 1d6 fire damage.

name: Stellar Shield Collapse
text: Trigger Your Solar Shield is destroyed while you have it raised. Requirements You haven't used Black Hole or Supernova within the last 10 minutes. Your solar shield collapses in on itself. Graviton-Attuned Immediately use Black Hole as a free action (if you have the Black Hole feat). Photon-Attuned Immediately use Supernova as a free action (if you have the Supernova feat).

name: Stellar Shield Collapse
text:
Trigger Your Solar Shield is destroyed while you have it raised.

Requirements You haven't used Black Hole or Supernova within the last 10 minutes.

Your solar shield collapses in on itself.

Graviton-Attuned Immediately use as a free action (if you have the Black Hole feat).

Photon-Attuned Immediately use as a free action (if you have the Supernova feat).

name: Step Between
text: Frequency: once every 10 minutes Requirements: You're adjacent to a vertical surface, such as a wall. You Stride. This Stride does not trigger reactions normally triggered by movement. You can move through other creatures' spaces as though you were Tiny. During this Stride, if you're ever not adjacent to the required surface, your Stride ends. Special: If you're , you can Step Between as long as you're touching any surface. You ignore the untethered condition during your Stride as part of this action.

name: Sticky Secretions
text: You produce abundant adhesive resin. You become trained in Athletics. If you're already trained in Athletics (from your background or class, for example), you become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude or Reflex DC against attempts to [[/act shove]] or [[/act reposition]] you. Additionally, you gain the reaction.

name: Stinging Tendril
text: Your tendrils have barbs that can deliver toxins. You gain a tendril unarmed attack that deals 1d6 poison damage in the dart weapon group and has the agile, finesse, injection, and unarmed traits. At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with this attack, you get its critical specialization effect.

name: Stinking Slime
text: Your slime assails the olfactory receptors. Non-osharu creatures that begin their turn adjacent to any square affected by Slime Squirt or Slime Spray must attempt a fortitude save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. On a failure, they become Sickened 1 (Sickened 2 on a critical failure).

name: Stitch Flesh
text: You can efficiently close wounds in the field. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Medicine checks to Treat Wounds and can do so in half the normal time.

name: Stocky Frame
text: Your squat form and low center of gravity make you remarkably sturdy. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to [[/act force-open]], [[/act reposition]], and [[/act shove]] as well as to your Fortitude DCs against attempts to Reposition and Shove you. When you succeed at an Athletics check to Reposition or Shove, you get a critical success instead.

name: Stone Climb
text: Your magical connection to stone allows you to climb it effortlessly. You gain a climb Speed equal to your land Speed; you can use this climb Speed only to climb stone.

name: Stone-Faced Inscrutability
text: Your mineralized mantle and practiced stoicism ensure that others sense your emotions only when you want them to. Other creatures take a –2 circumstance penalty to Perception checks to [[/act sense-motive]] against you. In addition, if you roll a success on your saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.

name: Stonecunning
text: You're attuned to the intricacies of stonework. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to notice unusual stonework and can attempt such checks even when not actively searching.

name: Stop Them in Their Tracks
text: Requirements You've Aimed at a target. With a deadly authority, you order your target to halt in their tracks, drop their weapons, and surrender. You attempt to Demoralize your mark. This check doesn't take the –4 circumstance penalty if the target doesn't share a language with you. On a critical success, your mark is also Immobilized for 1 round.

name: Streetwise
text: You know how to read the streets and find information in urban environments. You can use Society to Gather Information and to find black-market goods, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to these checks.

name: Strength in Numbers
text: Frequency once per 10 minutes Trigger You roll a saving throw. Requirements You're adjacent to two allies. Herd mentality is strong in humans, but it's also a survival mechanism that has stood the test of time and served them well. You roll the saving throw twice but must use the second result, even if it's worse.

name: Stretching Reach
text: You can leverage your size to extend your reach. When you wield a melee weapon that requires two hands and doesn't have reach, you can change between a typical two-handed grip and an extended two-handed stretch using an Interact action. Weapons wielded in your extended stretch gain a reach of 10 feet.
