name: Stretchy Strike
text: Your anatomy possesses a certain amount of flexibility that you can utilize to attack foes who would be just out of reach. Your unarmed attacks and melee weapons you wield gain a reach of 10 feet until the beginning of your next turn. Make a melee Strike against a creature within your reach.

name: Stride Between
text: You see and step into the liminal spaces that are hidden throughout the Universe. You Stride twice; these Strides do not trigger reactions normally triggered by movement.

name: Strike from the World's Core
text: You use the power of the world's core to move through the earth and Strike your foe. You gain the Drill Rush action and can use Channel the World's Core with a frequency of once per minute, rather than once per day.

name: Strobe Light
text: Frequency once per 10 minutes Trigger A creature hits you with an attack. Requirements You're aware of the attack and not Off-Guard against it. You strobe and pulse your brilliant light erratically, throwing off your attacker's aim at the last second with a display worthy of the hottest nightclubs and starriest skies. You become Concealed against the triggering attack.

name: Strobe Master
text: You have excellent light control and can strobe so fast that it makes would-be attackers sick. If a creature fails its flat check to hit you due to concealment caused by Strobe Light, it becomes Sickened 1.

name: Strong Swimmer
text: Whether the canal thruways of Jhavom, the seas off the coast of Zhast, or the murky depths of the Mire, you are no stranger to water and are strong from spending so much time swimming. Increase your swim Speed to 30 feet.

name: Stubborn Corpse
text: You're willful and stubborn, and you refuse to accept your own failure—traits that have served you well in life and after death. When you critically fail a saving throw against a mental effect, you get a failure instead. Additionally, you gain the Deny Failure reaction.

name: Stubborn Endurance
text: You're exceptionally difficult to kill. The DC of your recovery checks is equal to 9 + your dying value, or 8 + your dying value if you have the Toughness general feat. In addition, whenever someone returns you to life using magic that would normally leave you debilitated for a week (such as Raise Dead or the Resurrect ritual), you don't suffer that condition.

name: Student of the Canon
text: You have thoroughly studied religious doctrine. You automatically know the tenets of any major religion, and you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Religion checks to Recall Knowledge about religious texts and laws.

name: Student of the Unseen
text: You study the subtle, intangible forces that can be found in every particle and mote of magic in the universe around you. During your daily preparations, you can meditate on these spiritual and celestial mysteries and gain the Additional Lore skill feat in any Lore skill subcategory of your choice. This feat (and your proficiency in the Lore skill granted by it) lasts until you make your daily preparations again. Since both the feat and proficiency are temporary, you can't use them to satisfy a prerequisite for a skill increase or permanent character option (like a feat).

name: Student of War
text: Your psychic acuity lends itself to tactical analysis. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Recall Knowledge checks about creatures you observe in combat.

name: Stunt Double
text: You've trained hard to tackle physical challenges of all types as part of your entertainment career. You gain a climb Speed or a swim Speed equal to your land Speed. Special You can select this feat more than once.

name: Stunt Maneuver
text: Whether you're a natural ace or a veteran pilot, you can push a vehicle to perform incredible stunts. Remove the reckless trait when you attempt a Stunt with a –1 penalty. If you're a master in Piloting, remove the reckless trait when you attempt a Stunt with a –2 penalty or lower. If you're legendary in Piloting, remove the reckless trait from any Stunt you attempt.

name: Stunt Work
text: Frequency once per day Trigger You're about to roll a saving throw. You've performed countless risky stunts and flashy tricks for an audience, and your uncanny luck always seems to keep you safe. For the triggering saving throw, you can roll twice and take the better result.

name: Stupefying Presence
text:
Frequency once per day

You surround yourself with alien energy that befuddles those nearby. For 1 minute, you gain a stupefying presence aura in a 20-foot emanation around you. Enemies who enter the aura (or are in the aura when you activate it) must attempt a Will save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC with the following results. Afterwards, they are temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected by the presence.

Success The creature is Stupefied 1 for 1 round.

Failure The creature is stupefied 1 for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature is Stupefied 3 for 1 minute.

name: Sturdy Scales
text:
You've taken an alternative approach to strengthening your scales, gaining incredible strength quickly akin to a suit of armor. Your scales are a suit of medium armor in the plate armor group that grants a +4 item bonus to AC, with a Dex cap of +1, a check penalty of –2, a speed penalty of –5 feet, and a Strength value of 16.

You can never wear other armor or remove your scales; however, you still don't become fatigued from sleeping. Finally, you can etch armor runes or Affix Talismans onto your scales as normal for medium armor.

name: Sturdy Scrap
text: You build more durable temporary shells. The shield you create with Scrap Shield is tactical grade. You can create an advanced shield at 9th level, a superior shield at 13th level, and an elite shield at 17th level. In addition, you can use Scrap Shield to create a .

name: Sturdy Vine
text: You've grown a stout vine that you can use to bludgeon enemies. You gain a vine unarmed attack, which is in the brawling weapon group, deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage, and has the khizar, sweep, trip, and unarmed traits.

name: Subtle Coloration
text: You can alter your body's color to better vanish into your surroundings. As long as an observer is at least 20 feet away from you, you don't need cover from that observer to [[/act hide]] or [[/act sneak]]. This lasts until you move to an area with substantially different terrain.

name: Subtle Theft
text: When you successfully Steal something, observers (creatures other than the creature you stole from) take a –2 circumstance penalty to their Perception DCs to detect your theft. Additionally, if you first Create a Diversion using Deception, taking a single Palm an Object or Steal action doesn't end your Undetected condition.

name: Sucker Grip
text: Your limbs' myriad suckers provide you unrivaled grip strength,. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to [[/act force-open]], and you don't take an item penalty when Forcing something Open for not having a crowbar or other suitable tool. When you roll a success on a check to Force Open, you get a critical success instead. In addition, while you're in contact with a floor or other solid surface, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude and Reflex DCs against attempts to [[/act disarm]], [[/act reposition]], [[/act shove]], or [[/act trip]] you.

name: Suction Cups
text: You Change Shape to sprout hundreds of suction cups across your limbs. You gain a 15-foot climb Speed as long as you're wearing light armor or no armor.

name: Sudden Growth
text: You can infuse yourself with your burgeoning magical energy to increase your size for a short time. You can cast Enlarge on yourself as an innate spell of your heritage's tradition once per hour.

name: Sudo Spell
text: [one-action] If your next action Casts a Spell of 4th rank or lower with no duration, its energy echoes: you can Cast the Spell a second time before the end of your next turn without expending a spell slot.

name: Summerborn Awakening
text: Frequency once per day You tap into a primordial connection with the seasonal change your species bases much of its physiology on. You accelerate that change around you, tapping into primal powers to cause verdant growth nearby. For the next minute, each time you Step or Stride, you create difficult terrain in each square you leave during your movement that lasts for 10 minutes.

name: Summon Draconic Servitor
text: You call upon your connection to weaker dragons to summon a dragon to fight on your side. It might not be much of a combatant compared to you, but it can still provide support and draconic fury. Once per day, you can cast Summon Dragon as a 5th-level innate spell of your heritage's tradition.

name: Sun-Powered
text: Sunlight energizes your tiny frame. While in an area of bright natural light, you gain fast healing 1 and a +5-foot bonus to your fly speed.

name: Super Sensilla
text: You've practiced using your sensilla so much that they've developed into a permanent sensory organ. You have imprecise tremorsense with a range of 20 feet. When you Activate Sensilla, instead of its normal effect, you increase the range of your tremorsense to 100 feet until the start of your next turn.

name: Super Soul!
text: You've learned to open your mind to the wavelengths of those around you, beyond merely sensing their emotions. You gain limited telepathy. You can communicate mentally with creatures within 30 feet that share a language with you, and they can mentally respond. This doesn't give you any access to their thoughts and communicates no more information than normal speech would.

name: Super Sticky
text: Your body is very sticky. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude and Reflex DCs against attempts to [[/act reposition]], [[/act shove]], or [[/act trip]] you. This bonus also applies to saving throws against spells or effects that attempt to force you to move or knock you Prone. In addition, if any effect would force you to move 10 feet or more, you're moved only half the distance.

name: Superhero Landing
text: You spread the strain of your fall throughout your large build, cushioning the impact. Treat falls as 20 feet shorter. If you're an expert in Athletics, treat falls as 50 feet shorter, and 100 feet if you're a master. If you're legendary in Athletics, you always land on your feet and don't take damage, regardless of the distance of the fall. If you land Prone, you also land in quadrupedal posture regardless of your posture at the beginning of the fall and drop anything you were holding in your middle arms, unless you have Galloping Grip or another ability that allows you to hold objects in quadrupedal form.

name: Superior Customization
text: Your drone gains one superior customization, granting it a new ability. Special: you can select this feat up to three times.

name: Supernatural Soothing
text: When words fail and tempers flare, you center your emotions and then release your peaceful thoughts in a soothing, psychic calm. Once per day, you can cast either Calm or Clear Mind as an occult innate spell, heightened to half your level rounded up.

name: Supernova
text: While in photon mode, you can unleash a burst of stellar energy. Spend your full attunement to deal your solar manifestation's damage in a 10-foot burst centered on you (Reflex save for half).

name: Supersonic Speed
text: You move incredibly fast, becoming a colorful blur of erratic motion. When you Stride while Quickened from Zoomies, you gain concealment until the start of your next turn. As usual for concealment involving an obvious visual manifestation, you can't use this concealment to Hide.

name: Suppressing Fire
text: You gain the suppressing fire class feature.

name: Supreme Scion
text: You're among the most powerful scions of the fonqon trees. Choose one 3rd-rank primal spell and one 4th-rank primal spell. You can cast each of these spells once per day as primal innate spells.

name: Surface Strider
text: Through diligent training, you've learned to stretch your ability to remain out of the water for extended periods. You gain the amphibious trait.

name: Surprising Escape
text: Trigger You become Grabbed, Immobilized, or Restrained. Your extreme flexibility and deceptively compact frame make it easy for you to escape a variety of confines, and your quick reaction time means you can do so in a flash! You attempt to Escape.

name: Surprising Pop-Up
text: Requirements You're in quadrupedal posture. You're deft enough at using your middle limbs in both postures to immediately use them when changing. You Change Posture from quadrupedal to bipedal posture, Switch Hands from your top hands to your middle hands, and can Strike using a weapon in your middle hands or an unarmed attack.

name: Survey Wildlife
text: You can quickly assess the capabilities of creatures you observe. You can Recall Knowledge about a creature's abilities, weaknesses, and behaviors as a free action once per turn.

name: Survivor's Instincts
text: Trigger You are about to roll a Reflex save against a hazard You've learned to react to Akiton's dangers at a moment's notice, and you trust your instincts to see you through. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the triggering saving throw.

name: Swap Upgrades
text:
Frequency once per day

Requirements You are holding a repair kit, or you are wearing it and have a hand free.
You've meticulously prepared your gear to allow for quick adjustments in the field without damaging any delicate components. You draw and Install an Upgrade into a wielded weapon or worn armor. You can uninstall and stow an upgrade as part of this activity. If you have master proficiency in Crafting, you can Install two upgrades.

name: Swarm Evolution
text: Whether gradual or in an instant burst of glorious evolution, you've metamorphosed into a powerful Swarm-like creature. You gain a +2 status bonus to saves against fear, and you gain acid resistance equal to half your level. You can cast Mask of Terror as a 7th-rank primal innate spell once per day.

name: Swarm Tactician
text: You're adept at leveraging groups of allies to accomplish your goals. When at least two of your allies are flanking an enemy, that enemy is Off-Guard to your melee attacks.

name: Sway the Heart, Stoke the Spirit
text: You orate an inspiring speech that rallies your allies, cleansing their body and mind of harmful conditions and stoking their spirit for the ongoing battle. If you say this speech, Sway the Heart, Stoke the Spirit gains the auditory trait. If you sign this speech, Sway the Heart, Stoke the Spirit gains the visual trait. You and all allies in a type:emanation|distance:60 benefit from a 4th-rank Clear Mind and a 4th-rank Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Et8RSCLx8w7uOLvo spell. Additionally, your allies gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves for 1 minute.

name: Swear Vengeance
text: Frequency once per day Trigger You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed by a creature you're aware of. You swear vengeance against the creature who almost brought you down, committing yourself to their destruction. You avoid being knocked out and remain at 1 Hit Point, and your condition increases by 1. You also become for 1 round and can use the extra action to Stride toward or make a Strike against the triggering creature.

name: Swerveshift
text: Trigger A creature targets you with an attack. Requirements You are aware of the attack and are not Off-Guard to the triggering attack. You quickly Change Shape into a smaller size to avoid getting hit. You gain a circumstance bonus to AC, Fortitude DC, and Reflex DC against the triggering attack equal to the number of steps between your sizes when you Change Shape (+1 if you are one size smaller, +2 if you are two sizes smaller, and so on).

name: Swift Aim
text: Your Aim action costs only 1 action instead of 2, but the damage bonus is halved (minimum +1 die).

name: Swift Reposition
text: Trigger You're about to roll a Reflex saving throw, but you haven't rolled yet. Sensing danger, you can leap and twist your body away from the threat. You Step or Leap and gain a +2 circumstance bonus on your Reflex save. You must still roll the Reflex save even if this ability moves you out of range of the triggering effect.

Sensing danger, you can leap and twist your body away from the threat. You Step or and gain a +2 circumstance bonus on your Reflex save. You must still roll the Reflex save even if this ability moves you out of range of the triggering effect.

name: Swift Sneak
text: You can move your full Speed when you Sneak. You can use Swift Sneak while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.

name: Swimming Specialist
text: Whether by natural appendages or some personal modification, you can swim. You gain a swim Speed equal to your ancestry's Swimming Specialist entry.
